summary: Reviewed the exact candidate and its deterministic evidence. The supplied checks report Debug CTest 79/79, focused reference tests, differential fixtures at unchanged thresholds, ASan/UBSan and Release checks, one million fuzz cases with zero crashes or reports, and corpus validation for all 58 files with unchanged hashes and baselines. Bounds and diagnostics are covered; the supported-file delta is explicitly reported as zero. The documented terminal ledger preflight block and pending acceptance status were not treated as failures.
